description:
List your own away spans (PTO, holiday, sick, other), earliest first, including days your calendar booked off: each with id, kind, startDate, endDate (inclusive) and note. Pass from and to to list only the spans that overlap that range. Read them before anyforge_add_my_availability, since a span that overlaps one of yours is refused.

Always your own spans, the ones Settings → Capacity → Availability lists; there is no argument that names anyone else. Needs the role that adds a span in the Console (Operator or higher). Days a span covers are not counted by the "Log your time" reminder; time already booked on them stays booked.

from.description: Only spans that end on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: Only spans that start on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: anyforge_list_my_availability
title: List my availability
